sloka: अयं वातात्मजः श्रीमान्प्लवते सागरोपरि ।हनुमान्नाम तस्य त्वं मुहूर्तं विघ्नमाचर ॥५-१-१४६॥
transliteration: ayaṁ vātātmajaḥ śrīmānplavate sāgaropari ।hanumānnāma tasya tvaṁ muhūrtaṁ vighnamācara ॥5-1-146॥

translations.english: "The glorious son of the Windgod, called Hanuman, is crossing the ocean. Obstruct him for sometime by assuming the hideous form of a demon, gigantic as a mountain, fearful with yellowishbrown eyes, with big teeth and a wide mouth like the sky.
translations.hindi: उस समय का सुरसा का रूप ऐसा विकट भ्रौर भयंकर था कि, जिसे देख सब को डर लगता था । सुरसा, समुद्र के पार जाते हुए हनुमानजी का रास्ता छक कर, उनसे कहने लगी
